params: 2-8 region codes from one cohort: country codes (DEU, USA, BRA) or subregion codes of one country (US-CA, US-TX)
desc: Side-by-side headline comparison of 2-8 regions from one cohort. Returns usage index, augmentation/automation split, work/personal/coursework split, top job categories, request topics, work tasks.
limits: Indexes are normalized within one cohort and never compare across cohorts.
Regions publish different work-task subsets - compare tasks by name, not rank position.
Not evidence about employment or job automation.

desc: Anthropic Economic Index overview: coverage, releases, definitions. Returns latest data period, snapshot timestamp, dataset metadata, temporal coverage, geography and occupation coverage counts, worldwide headline split, definitions glossary.
limits: Takes no parameters at all.
The served numbers are a snapshot of the latest period, not a trend.

desc: Global Claude usage, occupational task breakdowns, and common request topics. Returns augmentation/automation and work/personal/coursework splits, task-time comparison, top job categories, top request topics, artifact types.
limits: Takes no parameters at all.

params: A job-category name, an exact occupation name, or a word from an occupation name. Omit for the job-category overview
Also return each occupation's per-task collaboration breakdown (adds up to ~90 KB)
desc: Occupations and job categories ranked by Claude usage of their tasks. A bare call returns category_shares for ~22 job categories.
limits: Global scope only - for one state or country use the subregion/country tools.
A gap between task_count and published_task_count is privacy suppression, not zeros.

params: ISO-3166 alpha-3 code, e.g. USA, GBR, DEU
Also return task_breakdown: job category to occupation to work-task hierarchy (adds roughly 60 KB)
Also return topic_breakdown: the request-topic hierarchy (adds roughly 50 KB)
desc: Full Claude-usage profile for one country. Returns usage index and rank, splits, top-10 job categories, request topics, work tasks, artifact types, with global baseline alongside.
limits: Only countries with observed usage above the aggregation threshold are covered.

params: ISO 3166-2 subregion code, e.g. US-CA, BR-SP, JP-13; a bare 2-letter code means a US state
Also return task_breakdown as flat node/parent rows (adds roughly 60 KB)
Also return topic_breakdown as flat node/parent rows (adds roughly 50 KB)
desc: Full Claude-usage profile for one subregion (state, province, prefecture). Returns rank within the country, splits, top-10 job categories, request topics, work tasks, artifact types.
limits: US states carry the Anthropic Usage Index; other subregions have no published index.
Empty lists mean not published - never invent entries.

desc: Every country with a published Anthropic Usage Index, ranked by it. Each row carries index and rank, splits, top-5 job categories, top artifact types, top-5 request topics with shares, and iso_numeric for a map join.
limits: Takes no parameters at all.

params: ISO 3166-1 country code, alpha-2 or alpha-3 (US/USA, BR/BRA). Default USA
desc: One country's subregions ranked by Claude usage. Defaults to the USA: all 50 states plus Washington D.C., ranked by the Anthropic Usage Index.
limits: Coverage varies by country; an empty result means no published subregions there.
Non-US subregions rank by usage share, which is volume, not engagement relative to population.

desc: Top work tasks worldwide, ranked by their 0-100 share of global sampled conversations. Task descriptions come from O*NET.
limits: Takes no parameters at all.
Returns the top 50 work tasks only.
